short_description: MIRSI (Mid-InfraRed Spectrometer and Imager) filters, Mauna Kea

licence.scope: No licence or reuse statement was found for the curves. Checked: the MIRSI instrument page at CfA (https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/mirsi/, redirects to lweb.cfa.harvard.edu/mirsi/; its footer has only an NSF grant sentence and a last-modified date), and https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/privacy-policy and /terms-use (both 404). The MKO site https://www.ifa.hawaii.edu/mko/ was not fetched. The MIRSI page is the one SVO cites. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
